stages.title: Stage 1A: Auto-Title Replacement, DeArrow Coexistence, Settings & Wide TTS Bar Layout Hardening

Fix getCardVideoId() ID truncation ({8,15} -> {8,32}) and preserve nested <yt-formatted-string> / .yt-core-attributed-string elements inside title links
Harden syncDeArrowState() + post-await guards in applyAiTitleToCard() for late & mid-flight DeArrow arrivals without losing _originalTitle
Deduplicate concurrent AI title requests via altTitleInFlight and deploy auto-title replacement ON by default with immediate Settings toggle reversion + cross-tab GM_addValueChangeListener sync
Fix wide floating window (~920px) TTS control bar overflow and speed pill vertical stacking in App.tsx
Unit test #21 + Playwright E2E Check 25 & Check 42 (21 assertions including 42a-42e async race) + live Chromium visual & persistence signoff

stages.title: Stage 1B: Multi-Team Adversarial Progress Retrospective, Issue Research & Roadmap Evolution
